subject.title: fix(feishu): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download

question: Should Feishu body-idle timeout inherit the existing effective Feishu HTTP timeout by default, or intentionally introduce a distinct 30-second body-idle policy?
rationale: Both choices are technically possible, but selecting a stricter default changes existing delivery behavior and requires explicit Feishu owner intent rather than contributor inference.

options.title: Preserve Existing Timeout Policy
options.body: Derive the chunk-idle deadline from the canonical Feishu timeout resolver for every media path and retain explicit account overrides.

options.title: Adopt A 30-Second Idle Policy
options.body: Keep a distinct 30-second default only with owner approval, clear upgrade rationale, and focused default-versus-custom timeout proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve Existing Timeout Policy
recommendation.body: Derive the chunk-idle deadline from the canonical Feishu timeout resolver for every media path and retain explicit account overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the current Feishu inbound-media behavior most directly.
